svg.title: A new conversation, a surviving workspace
svg.desc: Session one writes source and a handoff into the actor workspace. Session two starts with fresh model context and reads that workspace. Prior messages are not replayed. The coordinator and app persistence are separate state owners.
svg.text: A new conversation, a surviving workspace
12-call allowance; edit code and record what was checked
Edited source + handoff + application data files
12-call allowance; the prior message history is not replayed
Conversation reset is the tested boundary, not an arbitrary machine crash.
The coordinator owns trial IDs and exported evidence.
Application services own the consistency of persisted documents and indexes.
